name: hover-translator
description: Translate code and text on hover (identifiers, comments, strings, selections, prose). Free, no API key required.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Only reads hovered text and calls keyless translation APIs; never executes workspace code.

commands.title: Hover Translator: Toggle Auto-Translate Copied Text

translator.targetLanguage.markdownDescription: Language to translate into (ISO 639-1 code, e.g. `es`, `fr`, `de`, `ar`, `zh`, `ja`, `hi`, `pt`). Leave empty to use the editor's display language.

translator.sourceLanguage.markdownDescription: Source language code, or `auto` to detect automatically.

translator.email.markdownDescription: Optional email passed to MyMemory to raise the free daily limit from 5,000 to 50,000 characters. No signup required.

translator.libreTranslateUrl.markdownDescription: Optional self-hosted [LibreTranslate](https://libretranslate.com) endpoint (e.g. `http://localhost:5000`). Enables unlimited/offline translation.

translator.lingvaInstanceUrl.markdownDescription: Lingva Translate instance used as a fallback provider.

translator.maxSelectionLength.description: Maximum number of characters translated from a selection.

translator.cacheSize.description: Number of translations kept in the in-memory cache.

translator.translateIdentifiers.description: Translate identifiers under the cursor (splitting camelCase/snake_case into words).

translator.translateComments.description: Translate comment text under the cursor.

translator.translateStrings.description: Translate string-literal contents under the cursor.

translator.autoTranslateClipboard.markdownDescription: Automatically translate text you copy (e.g. from Claude/Codex/Copilot chat panels) and show it in a popup. The clipboard is only read, never overwritten, so your copied text stays intact. Toggle from the status bar.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run compile-tests
